correctness.rationale: The generator backward recursion is the standard Laguerre three-term recurrence with absorption at B and bottom zero, so the transform is 1/L_B(-s/B). Writing its denominator as A_B(s)=sum s^k/(k!)^2 prod_{j<k}(1-j/B) gives strict increase in B for s>0 (term k=2 is strict), bounded by I_0(2sqrt s). The product union bound 1-prod<=k(k-1)/(2B), including k>B, yields the all-B error; a second-order product remainder <=k^4/B^2 summed uniformly for s in [0,S] yields the positive B^-1 coefficient. Taylor coefficients give mean 1 and variance (B+1)/(2B); diffusion generator x d²/dx²+d/dx gives the I_0 hitting transform. Independently solved rational absorbing birth-death backward systems for B<=9 and s=1/2, matching Laguerre closed form. No claim of distribution-function stochastic order or finite monitoring intervals.
